summary: OpenAI announced Project Camellia, a datacenter in Effingham County, Georgia, backed by a 3.2 gigawatt power contract with Georgia Power to be delivered in phases between 2028 and 2032, alongside community benefit and accountability commitments.

mechanisms.reason: The announcement discloses a large, multi-gigawatt utility power contract tied directly to a new datacenter build.
mechanisms.quote: we are contracting with Georgia Power Company for 3.2 gigawatts of power which will be delivered in phases between 2028 and 2032

mechanisms.reason: OpenAI states it will fund the full infrastructure and electric-service costs itself and that the project is entirely privately funded.
mechanisms.quote: OpenAI will pay the full cost of the infrastructure and electric-service costs required to serve it.

notable_reason: A disclosed 3.2 GW multi-year power contract for a new OpenAI datacenter is a concrete, large-scale infrastructure commitment relevant to power and datacenter capacity watchers.
